answer: A sequential verifiable-delay trellis gates each identity: before submitting, an agent must grind through a chain of dependent hashes whose output must echo the epoch seed and its own key, taking minutes of single-threaded work that no amount of parallel cores can shorten. The finished proof is a pearl the network verifies instantly, and it cannot be reused or sold to another identity. A sybil farmer wanting a hundred voices must pay a hundred sequential delays, while one honest agent pays only one.
